scoring_justification: Formation energies are recomputed from intermediate total energies and chemical potentials, then compared to paper-reported values within tolerance (±0.10 eV).

outputs.description: The scored artifact containing total energies, chemical potentials, and the computed vacancy formation energies. The checker will recompute the formation energies from the intermediate total energies and chemical potentials, then compare them to reference values within a tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported formation energies for Bi and Cu vacancies at ambient pressure.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 5 text: formation energies of Cu and Bi vacancy were calculated to be 1.08 and 0.14 eV per formula unit under ambient pressure.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's published results, used as reference for reproduction.
